# Credit Risk Review for Loan Contracts

This document highlights critical areas for review concerning loan contracts:

*   Review of default risk based on audit findings.
*   Investigation of borrower credit scores for strategy 2026.
*   Investigation of collateral value based on audit findings.
*   Urgent monitoring of interest rates.
*   Re-evaluation of default risk based on audit findings.
